post.summary: DeleteClass removes an NFT class. Only allowed if the class has no NFTs.

RejectBid is used to reject a bid and set a new valuation for the NFT, to
prevent abuse a rejection fee as a percentage of the new valuation is paid
to the community pool.
Allow the denom root owner to set description only
Allow the denom root owner to set URI and URI hash only
SetListed sets the listed status for a specific NFT
SetNFTClassAlwaysListed sets the always_listed flag for an NFT class
Set per-class valuation fee percent and period

SetNameMetadata allows the owner of a name (NFT in nameservice.dys) to set
the metadata string for that name. Only the owner can call this.

denom.description: denom represents the string name of the given denom unit (e.g uatom).

exponent.description:
exponent represents power of 10 exponent that one must
raise the base_denom to in order to equal the given DenomUnit's denom
1 denom = 10^exponent base_denom
(e.g. with a base_denom of uatom, one can create a DenomUnit of 'atom' with
exponent = 6, thus: 1 atom = 10^6 uatom).

aliases.title: aliases is a list of string aliases for the given denom

cosmos.bank.v1beta1.DenomUnit.description:
DenomUnit represents a struct that describes a given
denomination unit of the basic token.

denom_units.title: denom_units represents the list of DenomUnit's for a given coin

base.description: base represents the base denom (should be the DenomUnit with exponent = 0).

display.description:
display indicates the suggested denom that should be
displayed in clients.

name.title: name defines the name of the token (eg: Cosmos Atom)

symbol.description:
symbol is the token symbol usually shown on exchanges (eg: ATOM). This can
be the same as the display.

uri.description:
URI to a document (on or off-chain) that contains additional information.
Optional.

uri_hash.description:
URIHash is a sha256 hash of a document pointed by URI. It's used to verify
that the document didn't change. Optional.

cosmos.bank.v1beta1.Metadata.description:
Metadata represents a struct that describes
a basic token.

cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.description:
Coin defines a token with a denomination and an amount.

NOTE: The amount field is an Int which implements the custom method
signatures required by gogoproto.

amount.title: Using the same annotation as MintCoins for consistency

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgBurnCoin.description:
MsgBurnCoins burns coins from the owner's balance, if each coin's root name
is owned by that owner.

authority.title:
authority is the address that controls the module (defaults to x/gov unless
overwritten)

name.title: name is the external name to create (e.g. "example.com", "sub.domain.org")

name_destination.title: name_destination must be a valid address

amount.description:
Using repeated cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin with the annotation
(gogoproto.castrepeated) = "github.com/cosmos/cosmos-sdk/types.Coins"
so that the generated Go code will have `Amount sdk.Coins` automatically.

mint_fee.description:
mint_fee is the explicit fee authorization provided by the caller.
It must be in udys and be >= the required fee computed as
sum(amount[i].amount) * params.mint_fee_per_coin (ceil to integer).

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgMintCoin.description:
MsgMintCoins mints coins into the owner's balance, as long as each coin's
"root name" is owned by that owner.

name_destination.description:
Signer must be the resolved destination of the root name of each coin denom
in all inputs.

inputs.description: One or multiple inputs: each account holding the coins.

outputs.description: One or multiple outputs: the account receiving the coins.

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgMoveCoin.description:
MsgMoveCoins force moves custom denom coins between two accounts if signer
owns the root name of each coin denom.

name_destination.title: Signer must be the resolved destination of the class root name

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgMoveNft.description:
MsgMoveNft force moves an NFT between accounts when signer owns the NFT
class.

rejection_fee.title: Fee collected by the community pool when a bid is rejected

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgSetDenom.description:
MsgSetDenomDescription lets the name destination of the denom root set
description.

authority.description:
authority is the address that controls the module (defaults to x/gov unless
overwritten).

metadata.description: The bank module metadata describing the denom, display, base, etc.

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgSetDenom.description:
MsgSetDenomMetadata allows a governance-authorized account to set denom
metadata.

MsgSetDenomMetadataResponse defines the response structure for executing a
MsgSetDenomMetadata message.

MsgSetDenomURI lets the name destination of the denom root set URI and URI
hash.

nft_owner.title: nft_owner is the address of the NFT owner

nft_class_id.title: nft_class_id is the identifier of the NFT class

nft_id.title: nft_id is the identifier of the specific NFT

listed.description:
listed determines if the NFT should be listed for sale but is overridden by
the NFTClass.always_listed parameter.

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgSetListe.description:
MsgSetListed sets the listed status for a specific NFT.
Only the owner of the NFT can update this setting.

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgSetListe.title: MsgSetListedResponse defines the response for MsgSetListed

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgSetNFTCl.description: MsgSetNFTClassAllowedDenoms sets the per-class allowed denoms list.

name_destination.title:
name_destination is the resolved destination address of the NFT class root
name

class_id.title: class_id is the identifier of the NFT class to update

always_listed.title:
always_listed determines if NFTs in this class should always be listed for
sale and override the listed status of the individual NFTs

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgSetNFTCl.description:
MsgSetNFTClassAlwaysListed sets the always_listed flag for an NFT class.
Only the owner of the NFT class root name can update this setting.

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgSetNFTCl.title:
MsgSetNFTClassAlwaysListedResponse defines the response for
MsgSetNFTClassAlwaysListed

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgSetNFTCl.description: MsgSetNFTClassBidTimeout sets the per-class bid timeout duration.

MsgSetNFTClassMinimumBidPercentIncrease sets the per-class minimum bid
increase percent.

MsgSetNFTClassRejectBidValuationFeePercent sets the per-class reject fee
percent.

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgSetNFTCl.title: Set per-class valuation fee percent (cosmos.Dec string)

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgSetNameM.description:
MsgSetNameMetadata allows the owner of a name (NFT in nameservice.dys) to set
the metadata string for that name. Only the owner can call this.

valuation.title: valuation is the new valuation of the NFT

max_valuation_fee_pct.description:
max_valuation_fee_pct (optional) is the maximum valuation fee percent the
user is willing to pay for setting the new valuation (e.g. "0.025" for
2.5% per valuation period). This guards against unexpected fee amounts if
the class updates valuation_fee_pct.

authority.description:
authority is the address that controls the module (defaults to x/gov unless
overwritten).

params.description:
params defines the x/nameservice parameters to update.

NOTE: All parameters must be supplied.

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.MsgUpdatePa.description: MsgUpdateParams is the Msg/UpdateParams request type.

MsgUpdateParamsResponse defines the response structure for executing a
MsgUpdateParams message.

mint_fee_per_coin.title: mint_fee_per_coin defines the fee in udys charged per coin minted

min_bid_timeout_class.title:
Bounds for per-class bidding parameters
Class bid_timeout must be within [min_bid_timeout_class,
max_bid_timeout_class]

min_reject_bid_valuation_fee_percent.title:
Class reject fee percent must be within
[min_reject_bid_valuation_fee_percent,
max_reject_bid_valuation_fee_percent]

min_minimum_bid_percent_increase.title:
Class minimum bid percent increase must be within
[min_minimum_bid_percent_increase, max_minimum_bid_percent_increase]

min_valuation_fee_pct.title:
Class valuation fee percent must be within
[min_valuation_fee_pct, max_valuation_fee_pct]

min_valuation_period.title:
Class valuation period bounds must be within
[min_valuation_period, max_valuation_period]

dysonprotocol.nameservice.v1.Params.description: Params defines the parameters for the nameservice module.
